## Checklist

- [ ] Changes are in `src/` only — `docs/` is untouched (the maintainer rebuilds it)
- [ ] Each folio is still **one A4 page** (`python3 tools/check.py --compile`, if you have TeX)
- [ ] Every new or changed fact has a source in the folio's header
- [ ] Dense facts and pictures — no interview Q&A, no filler, no wordy explanations
- [ ] Nothing internal or personal — hostnames, IP addresses, keys, personal data
- [ ] I dedicate this contribution to the public domain under CC0 1.0
